summary:
Added `--timeout-minutes` to the standalone Codex developer command. It accepts whole minutes from 1 to 60, rejects invalid values before cloning or model execution, and keeps the 30-minute default when omitted. The option is documented and tested.

Committed and pushed as `cecf2a847`. Ready PR: https://github.com/aws-e/adp/pull/6592

`npm run build` passed; `npm test` passed (132 tests, 0 failures). npm warned that the local Node v22 is below the package’s declared Node ≥24 requirement.
execution: standalone SDK developer on dev box; real GitHub and inference, native shell tools
validation: 132 package tests passed in the SDK run
